title: Very cheaply made; shipped inappropriately; lights are bright but lanterns are not built to last
text:
Very cheaply made; shipped inappropriately; lights are bright but lanterns are not built to last. There are two lanterns improperly shipped in a plastic envelope. Each lantern comes with three AA batteries already installed. However, one of mine had the cap fall off and the batteries spilled out with the tape removed from the batteries. In addition, that one sounds like there is a broken piece in the unit as I can hear it shaking around. Nevertheless, they both work.

There is both a side light and front like like a flashlight. The sides have to be expanded until the carry handle is stretched out all the way to expose the light. When the unit is compressed, it can be carried by the handle and used like a flashlight. The button at the base of the handle needs to be toggled on and off to get either the side light or front light to show. Note that there are no light modes (high, medium, or low) on this and no strobe.

I like that the lanterns can be carried and that it is versatile enough to stand up on its own. Inserting the batteries are also easy.

What I hate about this is that the units are not packaged appropriately for shipment. These are VERY CHEAP lights that I do not feel will last a long time. Also, the screw top that holds the batteries in the flashlight easily pops off. On one of mine, it kept falling off.
